ERROR.MINIMUM_COUNT_SELECTED: At least {{minimumCount}} checkboxes must be selected.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Accordion appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The three accordion appearances: filled, outlined, and text.

SIZES.TITLE: Accordion sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Accordions with different size options:dense, compact, comfortable, spacious.

ICON.TITLE: Accordion icons
ICON.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can have a custom icon on the left side of the header. If you don't specify whether it's a trailing or leading icon, the default setting will be a trailing icon.

HEADING_LEVEL.TITLE: Accordion heading level
HEADING_LEVEL.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can have a custom heading level. The default heading level is 2.

BUTTON_CONFIG.TITLE: Accordion button config
BUTTON_CONFIG.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can have a custom button config. You can specify the button type, color, and size. The default button config is a filled button with a primary color variant.

DISABLED.TITLE: Disabled accordion
DISABLED.DESCRIPTION: Accordions can be disabled. Disabled accordions cannot be opened or closed.

MULTI.TITLE: Multiple expanded items
MULTI.DESCRIPTION: By default only one accordion item can be open at a time. Set the "multi" input to allow multiple items to be expanded simultaneously.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Button appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The three button appearances: filled, outlined, and text.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Button variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Filled buttons with different color variants: primary(default), secondary, brand, surface, error, warning, success, light,light-fixed, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Button sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Buttons with different sizes: dense, compact, comfortable and spacious.

ICONS.TITLE: Button with icons
ICONS.DESCRIPTION: Buttons can have icons on the left and/or right side of the button text.

LINKS.TITLE: Button links
LINKS.DESCRIPTION: Buttons can be used as links by using the <a> tag.

BUTTON_GROUP.TITLE: Button group
BUTTON_GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Buttons can be grouped together to organize them.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Card appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The three card appearances: filled (default), outlined, and elevated.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Card variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Cards with different color variants: primary, secondary, brand, surface(default), success, warning, error, info, light, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Card sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Cards with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

ORIENTATION.TITLE: Card orientation
ORIENTATION.DESCRIPTION: Cards can be laid out vertically or horizontally.

CONTENT.VERTICAL_BODY: The header, media and body are stacked vertically.
CONTENT.HORIZONTAL_BODY: Horizontal card with the media placed next to the body content.

MEDIA.TITLE: Card media
MEDIA.DESCRIPTION: The media of a card can be stretched to fill the full width of the card, or kept within the card's default padding.

CONTENT.STRETCHED: Stretched media fills the full width of the card.
CONTENT.NON_STRETCHED: Non-stretched media keeps the card's default padding.

CLICKABLE.TITLE: Clickable card
CLICKABLE.DESCRIPTION: Cards become clickable when a click handler is attached, and can also be disabled.

FULL_COMPOSITION.TITLE: Full composition
FULL_COMPOSITION.DESCRIPTION: A card composed of a header (title and subtitle), media, body and footer sections to present rich content.

CONTENT.TITLE: Dandelion Meadow
CONTENT.SUBTITLE: Nature photography
CONTENT.BODY: A card can be composed of a header (title and subtitle), media, body and footer sections to present rich content.

APPEARANCES.TITLE: Chip appearances
APPEARANCES.DESCRIPTION: The two chip appearances: filled (default) and outlined.

VARIANTS.TITLE: Chip variants
VARIANTS.DESCRIPTION: Chips with different color variants: primary, secondary, surface (default), light, and dark.

SIZES.TITLE: Chip sizes
SIZES.DESCRIPTION: Chips with different sizes: dense, compact (default), comfortable and spacious.

INTERACTIVE.TITLE: Interactive chips
INTERACTIVE.DESCRIPTION: Use the ids-chip element for non-interactive chips, or the button[idsChip] selector for interactive chips. Interactive chips can also be disabled.

ICONS.TITLE: Chip with icons
ICONS.DESCRIPTION: Chips can include an avatar, a leading icon, and/or a trailing icon button.

REMOVABLE.TITLE: Removable chips
REMOVABLE.DESCRIPTION: Interactive chips can be made removable. The removed event is emitted when the close button is clicked.

CHIP_GROUP.TITLE: Chip group
CHIP_GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Chips can be grouped together. Appearance, size and disabled state are inherited from the group.
